name: Standex International Corporation
summary: Standex International Corporation, through it subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of products and services for commercial and industrial markets in the United States and internationally. It operates through Electronics, Aerospace & Defense, Scientific, Engraving & Hydraulics segments.
